summary: Advanced Energy Industries priced $1 billion 0% convertible senior notes due 2031 in a Rule 144A private offering. The conversion premium is ~50% above the May 13, 2026 closing price of $339.19. Issuer granted initial purchasers a 13-day option for an additional $150 million. Net proceeds (~$981M, or ~$1,128M if option exercised) will partially fund a capped call transaction and unwind existing hedges. Expect closing May 18, 2026. Watch for dilution management via the capped call and any impact from the concurrent note exchanges.
